title: How to spread your wings in IT? Self-development practices you can start using today

blocks.html:
The IT industry is constantly and rapidly moving forward. Market needs, top technologies and tools are changing. In order to be competitive in the market and climb the ladder of your dream career, you should take care of your professional development. How to keep up with all this? Where to start and how to go about it? What does a programmer have in common with a doctor and a lawyer?

During my presentation, I will answer these and other questions by presenting proven, practical and simple ways for self-development and accelerating your programming career.
